node.statement: Complementary source and target projections. In B=B_U direct-sum B_V put Pi_U=(I_{B_U},0) and Pi_V=(0,I_{B_V}); they are complementary source projections and their cross-corners vanish. In A_R, linearity of Co^A_{P_R}, P_R=P_U+P_V, and the corner-unit identity from lem-compcb-corner-algebra give P_U^R+P_V^R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_U+P_V)=Co^A_{P_R}(P_R)=u_R=I_{A_R}. Thus target complementarity has error zero, while both target projections are C_nest*t-projections, so all projection and complementarity requirements are bounded by C_cross^0*t.
